page.overview:
Who is Sébastien Bourdais?

Sébastien Olivier Bourdais (born 28 February 1979) is a former French Formula One driver who competed for Toro Rosso from the 2008 season until the 2009 season where he was replaced by Jaime Alguersuari at the Hungarian Grand Prix.
